title: JobSync tracks your job search with AI resume review
description:
JobSync tracks your job search with AI resume review
​
JobSync is a local web app that helps job seekers track applications and stay organized. It includes an AI resume review feature and runs entirely on your own system. Great for anyone managing an active job search.
​
https://github.com/Gsync/jobsync
